name: Moon Child
source:
every few hundred years, supernatural creatures gather for an ancient festival.
this year, nobody remembers how.

you arrive by train: a witch without a hat, in a forest that stopped celebrating a hundred years ago. The festival is coming, and the creatures who once danced there have their own reasons for staying away.

you have till midnight. find them, listen to them, and invite them back.

[From [url=https://edgyneer.itch.io/moon-child]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每隔数百年，超自然生灵们便会齐聚一堂，共赴一场古老的庆典。
可今年，谁也不记得该怎么举办了。

你乘着列车抵达此地：一名没戴巫师帽的女巫，踏入了一片百年前便已停办庆典的森林。庆典将至，而昔日曾在此翩翩起舞的生灵们，各有各不愿露面的理由。

距离午夜所剩时间不多了。去找到它们，倾听它们的心声，邀请它们重返庆典吧。

[摘自[url=https://edgyneer.itch.io/moon-child]itch.io[/url]]
